findings.note: NC House, third reading of committee substitute, 2018-12-05: yea (tally 67–40); census gate: none.
NC House, veto override, 2018-12-19: yea (tally 72–40); census gate: none.

She is listed among the co-sponsors (shown as 'White') of the constitutional amendment bill to require photo ID to vote, filed 2018-06-07. The bill is also on her own ncleg.gov introduced-bills list for the 2017 session. It became Session Law 2018-128.

She is listed among the co-sponsors (shown as 'White') of the bill titled 'Implementation of Voter ID Const. Amendment', filed 2018-11-27. It is on her own introduced-bills list for the 2017 session. The bill page gives only the title.

She is listed among the co-sponsors (shown as 'White') of 'Constitutional Amendment/Citizens-Only Voting', filed 2024-05-23. The page keywords include citizenship, voter registration and aliens. It was ratified as Session Law 2024-18. Related topic: non-citizen voting.
NC House, Third Reading (roll call #810), 2024-12-11: yea (tally 73–45); census gate: none.
